raw_html:
1.Determining Whether Two Random Variables are Independent Given the Joint PMF Only?

The joint probability distribution f(x,y) of the discrete random variables X and Y is given below.

f Y=0 Y=1
X=0 0.05 0.2
X=1 0.15 0.6

Which of the following statements are true?

  1. P(X=1,Y=1)=P(X=1)⋅P(Y=1)
  2. P(X=x,Y=y)=P(X=x)⋅P(Y=y) for all possible x and y
  3. X and Y are independent
